_about: Public-domain Soame Jenyns (1704-1787), Member of Parliament and lay apologist, for the Word Hoard: A View of the Internal Evidence of the Christian Religion (third edition, 1776), A Free Inquiry into the Nature and Origin of Evil (third edition, 1758) and Poems upon Various Subjects (1768). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 68 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jenyns-internal-evidence-1776: A View of the Internal Evidence of the Christian Religion, third edition (London: J. Dodsley, 1776)
jenyns-free-inquiry-evil-1758: A Free Inquiry into the Nature and Origin of Evil, in six letters, third edition, amended (London: R. and J. Dodsley, 1758)
jenyns-poems-1768: Poems upon Various Subjects, Latin and English (London: J. Nourse, 1768)

_excluded.jenyns-high-price-provisions-1767: Thoughts on the Causes and Consequences of the Present High Price of Provisions (London: J. Dodsley, 1767): anonymous, its title page names no author, and it is an economic pamphlet, not theology
